bead.title: claude-tui/gate: reconcile `claude --print` measurement section
bead.description:
PROBLEM: ADR-013's economic premise requires the `--print mode measurements` section to show exactly three complete empirical runs. Even after individual captures are added, the section still needs an aggregate reconciliation proving the parent verification requirements across all runs.

ROOT CAUSE: docs/helix/02-design/billing-observation-claude-tui.md:1 uses the `--print mode measurements` placeholder as the source of truth, but no aggregate check confirms exactly three labeled runs, six snapshots, three outputs, timestamp coverage, refresh-delay compliance, and whole-window single-account attestation.

PROPOSED FIX: Dependency ID: fizeau-a45dafe6. Governing artifact: ADR-013. Audit only the `--print mode measurements` section of docs/helix/02-design/billing-observation-claude-tui.md. Normalize labels to exactly `Run 1`, `Run 2`, and `Run 3`; remove accidental duplicate empty placeholders; verify each run has BEFORE and AFTER `/usage` snapshots, full turn output, wall-clock snapshot timestamps, completion timestamp, and proof that AFTER was captured at refresh-delay + safety margin, >=60s post-completion. Add or tighten a single-account attestation covering the full `--print` measurement window. Do not invent missing measurement data; if evidence is missing, mark the bead blocked and name the missing run evidence.

NON-SCOPE: PTY+hooks measurements, delta computation, verdict determination, ADR-013 disposition, methodology authoring, new `claude --print` captures unless replacing explicitly missing or malformed evidence is operator-approved.

AC:
1) TestPrintModeExactlyThreeRuns: doc's `--print mode measurements` section contains exactly three labeled runs: Run 1, Run 2, and Run 3.
2) TestPrintModeSixSnapshots: the three runs contain exactly six `/usage` snapshot blocks, one BEFORE and one AFTER per run.
3) TestPrintModeAllTurnOutputsPresent: each of the three runs has captured turn output.
4) TestPrintModeAllSnapshotTimestampsPresent: every `/usage` snapshot has a wall-clock timestamp.
5) TestPrintModeAllAfterRefreshDelaysVerified: every AFTER snapshot timestamp is >= that run's completion-time + documented refresh-delay safety margin and >=60s post-completion.
6) TestPrintModeWholeWindowSingleAccountAttested: the section attests no concurrent claude activity from the same account across the full `--print` measurement window.

GATES: `go test ./...` passes; `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
bead.acceptance:
1) TestPrintModeExactlyThreeRuns
2) TestPrintModeSixSnapshots
3) TestPrintModeAllTurnOutputsPresent
4) TestPrintModeAllSnapshotTimestampsPresent
5) TestPrintModeAllAfterRefreshDelaysVerified
6) TestPrintModeWholeWindowSingleAccountAttested
Gates: `go test ./...`, `lefthook run pre-commit`.
